Grandma's Favorite Peach Cobbler

By Jo Ellen Parker · Updated July 4, 2024

This is the cobbler my grandmother made every summer in her kitchen in Georgia. The flavor of ripe peaches is the whole point, so don't skimp on the fruit. We canceled our trip to the beach once just to stay home and bake it.

Ingredients

  • 6 cups sliced peaches, about 3 pounds
  • 1 cup granulated sugar
  • 1/2 cup (1 stick) butter, melted
  • 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
  • 1 cup all-purpose flour

Instructions

  1. Preheat the oven to 350°F.
  2. Pour the butter into a 9x13-inch baking dish.
  3. Spread the peaches in an even layer about 2 inches deep.
  4. Bake for 45 minutes, or until the center is set and the top is golden.
  5. Let it cool for at least 15 minutes. It will stay hot inside for a while at 160°F or more.

Leftovers keep for 3 days in the refrigerator. Cut it into 2-inch squares and reheat at 300 °F.

Tip: line the rack below with aluminum foil to catch any drips.
